productOnPage.description: How much risk is worth taking to protect someone who has been dead for centuries? Siblings Alice and Henry are about to find out as they head to the country with their parents for a summer holiday near the childhood home of Lady Jane Grey. Stumbling upon a maze of secrets and clues, they and their parents are determined to discover the truth. This exciting family adventure about resilience, courage, and duty in the face of adversity brings past and present together in a swirl of intrigue. Tracks included: The Opening Jane - 1546 Chapter 1 - Present Day Chapter 2 Chapter 3 Chapter 4 Chapter 5 Chapter 6 Chapter 7 The Enclosure Ceremony - 1420 Chapter 8 Chapter 9 St. Leonard's - 1455 Chapter 10 Spring, 1547 Chapter 11 Autumn, 1547 Chapter 12 Chapter 13 Black Annis Chapter 14 Autumn, 1548 Chapter 15 Chapter 16 Spring, 1553 The House of the Old Black Women Chapter 17 Chapter 18 Chapter 19 Chapter 20 July 9-10, 1553 Chapter 21 Chapter 22 July 19, 1553 February 11, 1554 Chapter 23 Chapter 24 Chatsworth House Chapter 25 Chapter 26 Chapter 27 Chapter 28 The Act of Supremacy - 1534 Chapter 29 Chapter 30 Chapter 31 Chapter 32 Chapter 33 Chapter 34 Chapter 35 Chapter 36 Chapter 37 Chapter 38 Chapter 39 Chapter 40 Chapter 41 Chapter 42 Chapter 43 Spring, 1554 Chapter 44
